node.statement: The exact external contract for lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation asserts existence of an error-improved map v_R, the inequalities d_R <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_R and ||v_R(I_{B_R})-u_{A_R}|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_R, preservation of bijectivity when applicable, and unchanged source, target corner, and amplification form. It does not assert an extended-inclusion tag for v_R. The registered def-maincb-reset-state treats the map-defect number and inclusion/isomorphism tag as separate supplied fields and explicitly exports no invariant connecting them, while no other allowed definition defines error-improved map. Hence the former extended-d_R-inclusion assertion was unsupported and has been removed; completing the root requires a strengthened validated external contract or a separate permitted validated bridge exporting that tag.
